reviews.comment: Mr. Boas's class was good for students who took Calc in HS, but the method he teaches would definitely be challenging for new students. There is no homework and the test are slightly demanding. He does cold-calls students to answer moderately difficult questions, but you get to bring your neighbors. However, there is extra credit and (okay) JOKES!!

MATH 300 was more work than I initially expected, but it was clearly outlined in the provided syllabus. There is one assignment due every day (consisting of writing assignments, textbook readings and quizzes about the readings) and in class, participation definitely matters (w/ PollEv and writing on the board) He's caring and bumped me!

Spring '23: Honestly just keep up with all the assignments and you will be fine in this class. Professor Boas is super caring and makes an effort to make his lectures interesting and engaging. Quizzes and readings due every other day, proofs due once a week. Exams weren't too bad, just make sure you memorize the theorems he puts on the study guide.
Very kind man and does a great job explaining and helping students. 10/10.

Fall 2020:
Boas was a wonderful professor! The textbook he chose was especially well-written and very helpful. He is very caring, patient, was able to teach an organized and interesting course online during covid times. He's approachable and his hw requirements are very reasonable. We did not have tests, just hw. He wants students to succeed!

If you translate "Boas" from Portuguese, you get "good", and I believe that's a good way to describe Dr. Boas. In all seriousness, he is amazing, and even though it's been a semester since I took him, I know that his passion for math radiated through his lessons and onto the students, and I became convinced to get a math minor because of him.11/10

Superb math 300 professor. Pros: teaches difficult material in an easy way for students to graps. He makes sure everyone understands and is always open for questions. You will have something due every night in this class BUT it is worth it. There are NO tests. Weekly: 1 proof/ 3 hard quizzes/3 readings. Lectures reinforce what you read.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had by far. I dropped his class when covid started because I couldn't keep up with all the assignments (each lecture has a quiz after and there's a weekly proof assignment) but this last semester I took him made fall in love with math all over again. Every math major should try to take a class with him, you won't regret it!

Perfect professor, not only teachs you knowledge, but also helps you to love math. This lecture opens a window to math, after taking this course, you will know the language of mathematics and which topic to take in the future. Don't hesitate to take him.

He is so far my best math teacher. His class is kind of easy if you don't skip and pay attention. No test at all, but lots of quizzes and proof assignments, 2 essays. Proofs was the hardest part of this class, but he curves at the end of semester. Love him.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: this guys the goat. very good teacher, cares a lot about students and if they are understanding concepts. He doesn't take attendance, but he calls on people randomly in class which is a bit stressful. If you don't answer correctly he doesn't embarrass you or anything tho he's very kind. Also likes to do small group stuff in class and has u present.

nice, caring, easy going. Have quite a few quizzes. I would say he's a nice grader generally. He really likes to do small group stuff. This class isn't too useful for me but Boas was the best option and he really is amazing at what he does. He answers emails pretty quick and with clarity, no major complaints for him, he is really good, I'm not.

Fantastic professor, he is so caring and invested in his students. He will take the time to answer any questions you have and loves when you ask them! Usually have quizzes on Wednesday but occasionally group quizzes if the class feels like they would learn better that way. Truly aims the class in the direction the students need.

Amazing prof, going to his office hours was extremely helpful. He explains concepts very well, and makes sure that everyone understands the material. You do still have to work for a good grade, but if you pay attention and go to his office when you don't understand something, you should have a good shot at an A.

The bestestestest math teacher I ever got. after taking multiple math classes with bad teachers under math department in Tamu, he truly changed my notion about the dept. He cares for students like they are his own children. But im not saying he gives out free grades, you gotta work hard. i pass with a C but still praising him coz hes really good.
Great professor! He presents very complex math topics in easy to understand ways. His exams are pretty tough, but if you study you can do well. Also he loves cheesy math jokes, it's a great time!

GOD BLESS BOAS. The most amazing professor I've ever had. 409 is by far the hardest math class and he made it totally doable. It was hard but going to office hours for homework was very helpful and shows him that you care. His math jokes and overall awesomeness turned an awful class into a fun and memorable one. Take Boas if you get the chance!!!

I had Boas for MATH 409, considered to be one of the harder undergrad math courses. He does a phenomenal job explaining the concepts in a way that just about any student who's taken at least Calculus I will understand. He definitely has a gift for teaching higher math - I highly recommend taking him next time he teaches ANY 400 level math class!
If you ever have the opportunity to take a class from him,  take it! Honestly best prof f on campus.

The greatest math professor I've ever come across in my whole life. Totally unique way of teaching. Besides, in the office hours, I have never seen such a friendly professor who can help you for anything and everything... simply AWESOME!!!...He is my inspiration.
Best math teacher I have ever had (and I've taken a lot of math classes).  Very clear in his teaching, and will go the extra mile to help you.
